_comment: Metafield definitions. Four of them, and each exists because something on a
page needs a fact that Shopify has no native field for.
EVERY DEFINITION IS PINNED. An unpinned definition is invisible in the admin
form, and the Girlyf team would reasonably conclude the feature is missing.
Pinning is not cosmetic here — it is the difference between a field they use
and a field they never find.
There are no metaobjects. Girlyf has no fact that two products would share
the identical text of — unlike Homingo, whose material and care copy is keyed
by material family. If that changes, a metaobject is the right answer, not a

definitions.name: Free size
definitions.description: Set by the fill-sheet importer, not by hand. True when a ring is adjustable rather than sized, and the theme renders it as a badge. Only rings answer this at all — a necklace leaves it blank.
definitions._why: The checklist asked for adjustable pieces to be 'labelled clearly to reduce returns'. A badge driven by data does that; words someone remembers to type into a title do not.

definitions.name: Reels
definitions.description: Styled vertical clips, usually repurposed from Instagram. These render in their own strip, deliberately NOT in the product media gallery. A worn/turning trust video belongs in the gallery instead — upload that as ordinary product media.
definitions._why: A 9:16 marketing clip sitting between two packshots makes the gallery incoherent. Different role, different surface.

definitions.name: Combo contains
definitions.description: The individual pieces inside a pre-packed combo. Lets the product page say what is in the box and link to each piece. Set this by hand, once per combo — the fill sheet lists handles, which are not Shopify references.
definitions._why: A combo without this is a mystery box with a photo. It is also the one field the sheet describes but cannot deliver.

definitions.name: Category tile clip
definitions.description: A 3–5 second loop standing in for this category's static tile image. Muted, no audio track, under 8MB, with a poster frame. One per category.
definitions._why: A Shopify collection has one image field and no video field, so the guidelines' looping category tiles are not expressible natively.
